answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the ocean of a task receipt, and the orchard is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, converted to a slow vesting stream. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the lagoon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
